theme_and_archetype.reasoning: High energy, command-center feel tailored for an athletic and data-heavy NHL fantasy sports platform. Uses tactical minimalism and high-contrast numerical displays.

headings.usage_rules: Must use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight or tracking-tighter). Used for massive metrics and section titles. Projects a 'heavy-weight' athletic feel.

body.usage_rules: Clean numerical reading. Used for tables, standard text, and data points.

labels.usage_rules: Overlines/Labels MUST be Uppercase + Tiny + Wide Spacing (tracking-[0.2em]).

anti_patterns: Do NOT use Inter, Roboto, or Open Sans for headings. No soft, rounded fonts.

colors.usage_rules: Deep Obsidian (#0A0A0A) anchors the UI. Pure white for text ensures data clarity. Electric Ice Blue and Alert Red are kinetic triggers for actions. Never use pure #000000, always tint slightly.

layout_and_spacing.grid_strategy: MODE B: THE CONTROL ROOM GRID
layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: p-4, p-6, p-8. Containers with borders MUST have internal padding (p-6) to prevent text collision.
layout_and_spacing.alignment: Strict grid hierarchy. Left-align dense content and tables. No jagged bottoms; use h-full on children.
layout_and_spacing.mobile_rules: Mobile-first responsive grids. Always start with grid-cols-1.

components_and_surfaces.cards: Flat solid surfaces. 1px solid borders (border-white/10), NO soft shadows. Radius max 4px to 8px for sharp, tactical aesthetics.
components_and_surfaces.headers: Solid background with a harsh bottom border (border-b border-white/10). No muddy glassmorphism for data-heavy apps to ensure clarity.
components_and_surfaces.buttons: High-saturation accent blocks. Sharp corners or subtle 4px radius. MUST have explicit hover state text color.
components_and_surfaces.inputs: Shadcn based. Flat styling. Focus states must have 2px inner ring using the brand primary color.
components_and_surfaces.tables: Shadcn table component. Dense spacing, left-aligned columns, distinct border-b on header rows.
components_and_surfaces.charts: Shadcn/Recharts. Use color-blind friendly palettes or brand accent colors. Tooltips must have dark opaque backgrounds.
components_and_surfaces.navigation: Visible navigation bar on desktop. Include Logo, 3-5 key links, CTA.
anti_patterns: NO neomorphism. NO soft fuzzy shadows. NO full-screen gradients.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Crisp and instant. Background lightness increases or explicit border color change.
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Use specific properties: transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease. NO 'transition: all'.
motion_and_interactions.accessibility: Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Focus rings must be highly visible.
motion_and_interactions.data_loading: Minimalist pulse or sharp skeletal loading screens, not soft fading.

media_and_assets.hero_overlay: Gradient overlay for contrast (e.g., bg-gradient-to-t from-[#0A0A0A] via-[#0A0A0A]/80 to-transparent).

hero_background.description: A hockey goalie stands near the net on ice. Use as login/hero background overlay.

stadium_ambience.description: People playing ice hockey on stadium. Use for feature section backgrounds or promotional areas.

testing.attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include 'data-testid' attribute (kebab-case, role-based).

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement Shadcn/UI for foundational components (Tabs, Tables, Dialogs, Select) but override soft styles with sharp, tactical 1px borders.
Apply Archetype 2: The Performance Pro theme globally.
Do NOT guess image URLs. Use the provided ones strictly.
Implement a dashboard 'Control Room' feel using the CSS grid specifications.
Ensure high contrast on all numerical data (pure white text on dark background).
